title: Old Flame
description: This “enthralling” (TheNew York Times Book Review) and “introspective, energetic novel” (Booklist) explores what it means to be a woman in her many forms - daughter, friend, partner, lover, and mother - from the acclaimed author of Tuesday Nights in 1980.Emily writes for women’s catalogs for a living, but she’d rather be writing books. She has a handsome photographer boyfriend, but she actively wonders how and whe...
